test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What model did the Forest Officer AK Banerjee use to rejuvenate a degraded forest in West Bengal?

options.text: He stopped the felling of old trees.
He involved local people in silviculture.
He controlled termites and other wood-destroying insects.
He made a canal waterway in the forest to help the plants to grow.

solution:
The correct answer is__** He involved local people in silviculture**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Forest Officer A.K. Banerjee successfully rejuvenated a degraded forest in West Bengal using a model of Joint Forest Management (JFM).
 
• A.K. Banerjee involved local communities in silviculture and forest protection activities.
 
• Silviculture involves the scientific cultivation and management of trees.
 
• Local people were encouraged to participate in forest restoration efforts by planting, nurturing, and protecting trees.
 
• Benefit to Local People:
 
• In return for their participation, local communities were given a share of the forest produce and benefits, including access to non-timber forest products (NTFPs) like fruits, fodder, and firewood.
 
• Result:
 
• This participatory model transformed the degraded forest into a thriving green area, showcasing the success of community-based forest management.
 
• This approach underlines the importance of community involvement in sustainable environmental management.
